## Operator remediation — apply the value_wo migration, scrub existing cleartext from remote state, and rotate the exposed crown-jewel secrets

This is the PROD-mutation follow-through for the code change landed under
`finedrawn-closed-stud` (eb67-b96c-dcf0-4f86), which migrated every SSM SecureString
**secret** parameter to terraform write-only arguments (`value_wo` / `value_wo_version`)
so secret values are never persisted to terraform state (ADR 0105). The code change alone
does NOT mutate prod; this ticket is the operator cutover.

**Run this only AFTER the value_wo code change has landed on main.** Follow the procedure in
`infra/runbooks/ssm-secret-write-only.md` §"REMEDIATE the existing exposure".

### Steps
1. `terraform apply` the value_wo migration. NOTE the one-time cutover reset: on this apply
   `value_wo_version` goes absent -> 1 for each migrated slot, so the provider re-sends
   `value_wo = "CHANGEME"` once and RESETS each live seeded secret to the placeholder. This is
   intended (we rotate these secrets in the same window). `user_data.sh`'s CHANGEME fail-fast is
   the safety net.
2. In the SAME maintenance window, re-seed/ROTATE every affected secret out-of-band
   (`aws ssm put-parameter --overwrite`). Rotate the crown-jewels explicitly — they were exposed
   in cleartext in state and must be treated as compromised: Gerrit admin password, opcert
   Ed25519 signing key, rebar-bot signing key, Anthropic API key, jira-api-token, SSH host keys.
   Update every external system that trusts an old value (Gerrit account, Jira token, bot public
   key, Anthropic console).
3. VERIFY no SecureString value appears in state: `terraform state pull` must show `value: null`
   (and no `value_wo`) for every migrated secret. Only the generated `opcert_origin_guard`
   legitimately still resolves (via its random_password).
4. SCRUB the historical cleartext from the state backend: the prior values persist in the retained
   versions of `s3://rebar-tfstate-896586841071/rebar/prod/terraform.tfstate` (bucket versioning,
   ~149 versions). Permanently delete the affected object versions (or roll the bucket / lifecycle-
   expire old versions per data-handling policy). Rotated values are retired but still purge them.

### Coordination
- Coordinate with the SEPARATE "rubied" apply that is seeding 4 new MCP-PAT SSM params so the
  state scrub covers those params too (they are also SecureString secrets under /rebar/prod/).
- Cross-reference: ADR 0105 (docs/adr/0105-ssm-secrets-never-in-terraform-state.md) and the runbook
  infra/runbooks/ssm-secret-write-only.md.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] value_wo migration applied to prod.
- [ ] Every migrated secret re-seeded/rotated; crown-jewels rotated and external trust updated.
- [ ] `terraform state pull` shows no SecureString secret value (all `value: null`, no `value_wo`).
- [ ] Historical cleartext purged from the state bucket's retained versions.
- [ ] rubied MCP-PAT params covered by the same scrub.

## Verification
- Before any state surgery, confirm S3 versioning on `s3://rebar-tfstate-896586841071` and write a names-only SSM parameter snapshot to a local project/session artifact, never values.
- `terraform plan` in `infra/terraform` must show no destructive changes outside the approved value_wo/state-scrub/rotation scope before any apply.
- After the apply/rotation, verify `terraform state pull` has no cleartext SecureString values (`value: null`, no `value_wo` material) without printing secret values.
- Verify every rotated self-regenerable secret's consumers have restarted or re-read the parameter and health checks pass.
- Verify historical cleartext tfstate object versions were removed or retired per the runbook, recording only object/version identifiers and secret names as needed.


## Completion Scope Adjustment (2026-09-07)
The operator's 2026-09-06 approval narrowed autonomous rotation: rotate ONLY secrets that can be regenerated internally in this session, and flag third-party or externally anchored credentials for a human/operator who can reissue the external trust. The executable close scope for this ticket is therefore: value_wo already applied, live/current tfstate and retained historical tfstate versions scrubbed of non-generated SecureString values, and internally self-contained secrets rotated. Externally anchored secrets are tracked in follow-up `auspicial-wily-warbler`, linked `discovered_from`, and are intentionally not blockers for this ticket's close under the narrowed operator instruction.
